decisionTime.meaning: Evidence and value as saved when the decision was made. Later changes to evidence rules do not rewrite it.

data.authorityBoundary: Smart Opportunity is the sole BUY/WATCH/VERIFY/PASS recommendation authority. The Expert Advisor explains linked evidence and produces PSA grading guidance only. It cannot create, upgrade, replace, or silently recalculate the saved opportunity recommendation. Any unresolved recommendation or card-identity conflict between the saved opportunity and attached PSA snapshot is displayed read-only; the saved opportunity remains authoritative and the conflict must be resolved through the existing guarded recalculation workflow. Canonical duplicate sold-source variants enter PSA grade lanes only when sale amount, sale date, and grade/condition agree; contested copies remain visible and are excluded. Rejected, duplicate, active, unlinked, unsupported-grade, and review-required evidence stays visible and cannot enter supported sold-value lanes.

decisionInterpretation.confidenceMeaning: Confidence is a rule-based 0-100 score of evidence strength. It is not a probability and has not been calibrated against independent outcomes.
decisionInterpretation.explanation: FlipForge needs more confirmation (identity, listing or sales evidence) before the price can be judged. VERIFY sets no buying limit.
decisionInterpretation.maximumBuyPresentation: VERIFY sets no buying limit. Any figure calculated with this decision stays unchanged in the saved record and is not a buying limit.

decisionRules.disclosure: Decided on Nov 14, 2026 under earlier rules. This saved decision, its Max Buy and its receipt are kept exactly as they were made. Today's rules can give a different result at the same price; any analysis under today's rules is shown separately.

marketplaceSaleDetails.notice: Individual marketplace sale details (title, price, sale date and link) are not shown. Counts, match status and FlipForge's own figures are shown instead. The saved decision is unchanged.

currentAdmission.meaning: Current eligibility under today's evidence rules. It does not change the saved decision.

limitations: Decision support is not a guaranteed buying or selling outcome.
Active listings and fixed-price asks never become completed-sale evidence.
Population context cannot predict the grade a raw card will receive.
Analog value-intelligence ranges are read-only context from governed saved evidence; they never become exact supported value or recommendation authority.
Provider credentials and provider-administration data are not included.
Rejected, active, mismatched, unlinked, candidate-only, and historically accepted rows that fail current exact-comparable rules remain visible but cannot support value authority.
